request.prompt: Owner now explicitly requests ALL other screens of the existing SPIKE trade-recording app follow the new Apple Glass visual language. Create a cohesive design board with FIVE 390px mobile screen examples plus shared CSS/component tokens: 合约(order ticket), 纪律(rules), 持仓(positions), 统计(statistics), 设置(settings). Title SPIKE 全应用 Apple Glass 统一升级. Use the selected final 1.618 screen as style reference. Keep its wallpaper chart screen intact. Other screens remain naturally scrolling content, NOT candlestick wallpapers. Minimal Apple SF system typography, luminous cool white canvas with extremely subtle blue/green ambient light, generous spacing, translucent glass capsules/cards (rgba white .6-.8, backdrop blur 24-32px, fine white specular edges), restrained blue interaction accent, green/red only trade direction/PnL. Floating bottom nav exact order 合约、纪律、1.618、持仓、统计, center1.618 once with candlestick icon, consistent across screens. Remove heavy opaque panels, overly rounded card nesting, busy decorations. Maintain all existing semantics: Contract: symbol/quote, optional chart, remaining discipline quotas, long/short market/limit, leverage, server 1R auto stop, margin allocation slider, estimates, account value, explicit buy/sell submit, protection explanation. Rules: current active policy, risk/slots/day budget/cooling/protection, pending-policy state clearly distinct. Positions: positions and pending/closed tabs, each position actual values, protection status, proportional-close dialog and error/empty states. Statistics: totals and weekly/monthly/year filters, calendar/returns curve/trade history, empty state means no fabricated success. Settings: device authorization/account switch, confirmation preference, haptics, connectivity; preserve all toggles and no extra settings. Use placeholder numbers only, no private account data. Keep all labels readable, touch targets44px, 320px fallback, max480px desktop shell. Motion: 260-340ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), modest press .97, smooth segmented/nav indicator and sheets, no perpetual animations, honor reduced-motion. Provide actual HTML/CSS source and rendered screen(s), not only prose. Do not invent buttons or alter any risk/fee/order rules.
